flow.layersText: app/server → mcp → core → sources/shared. Lower layers never import upper ones; the app talks to the server only over HTTP.

sources.title: Public sources
sources.text: Adapters fetch and parse EXBO, the wiki, skins, prices, icons and the STALZONE profile. They never write to the database.

sync.title: Sync
sync.text: The sync module normalizes the responses, writes rows and records freshness. A failed source becomes stale; old data stays.

sqlite.title: SQLite
sqlite.text: One WAL database is the only source of truth. There is no second store, worker or cache.

core.title: Core modules
core.text: Each bounded context owns its tables; calc/ is the only place that produces DPS and TTK numbers.

clients.title: Consumers
clients.text: The payload read model feeds the Nuxt screens, the REST API, MCP and the CLI from the same rows.

entry.title: Entry point
entry.text: A form, an agent or a terminal calls the API, MCP or the CLI. Nothing writes SQL directly.

service.title: Write service
service.text: The owning module validates with zod, checks ownership and builds the before/after diff.

transaction.title: One transaction
transaction.text: The change and its event_log entry commit together; a dry run writes nothing.

result.title: Result
result.text: Callers get the dryRun flag, diff and eventId. Rollback restores the snapshot and logs a new event.

api.note: Every write accepts a dry run (dryRun in the body or dry_run in MCP) and returns the same dryRun, diff and eventId result. Mutations also require the matching Origin or a bearer token.

singleSource.title: One database, one process
singleSource.text: SQLite in WAL mode is the only source of truth. The site, API, MCP and CLI all read and write the same file; there is no second store or worker.

journal.title: Every write is reversible
journal.text: Each change commits together with an event_log row that holds before/after snapshots. Rollback restores the entity and logs itself.

numbers.title: No invented numbers
numbers.text: A missing lot, stat or price stays null and renders as “no lot” or “no data”. Zero, missing and estimated values never substitute for each other.

formula.title: One formula for DPS and TTK
formula.text: Every displayed damage number comes from catalog/calc/weapons.ts. Stored legacy display values are never substituted.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.text: No game credentials, no Steam or EXBO sign-in and no reading game files. Only public HTTP sources; the auction is read-only.

auth.title: Session and origin checks
auth.text: A scrypt password, an HttpOnly session cookie, a required Origin on mutations and a bearer token for /mcp.

keep.title: This page is part of the contract
keep.text: Adding or removing a screen, endpoint, MCP tool, CLI script or source requires updating this page. The test compares it with the code on every run.
